answer: The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, capped per identity per epoch, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Every claim climbs the jetty of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the willow re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the ferrous of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
